subtitle: Your business details appear on receipts and invoices.
loadFailed: Couldn't load settings. Check your connection.

business.title: Business
business.description: Company details for receipts and A4 invoices.
business.name: Business name

hints.legalName: If different from the business name, e.g. "Corner Cafe LLC".

money.title: Money
money.defaultTaxHint: Pre-filled on new products. Existing products keep their rate.
money.maxDiscountHint: The most anyone except you can take off an item or a sale. Leave blank for no limit.

documents.title: Receipts & invoices
documents.languageHint: Receipts, quotes, invoices, the customer display and receipt emails use this language. Each person's screens use their own.

logo.title: Logo
logo.help: Shown on receipts and invoices. PNG with a transparent background works best; large images are shrunk automatically.
logo.unreadable: That file isn't an image we can read
logo.wrongType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image
logo.tooDetailed: That image is too detailed to fit in 300 KB — try a simpler logo

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Each store's address and phone print on its receipts.
stores.name: Name
stores.printedHint: Address and phone are printed on this store's receipts.
stores.badTimezone: Unknown timezone — use a name like Europe/Paris

regimeHint.GERAL: Products use their own rate (14% general by default); exemptions and reduced rates per product.
regimeHint.SIMPLIFICADO: Every line is exempt with M00 "IVA – Regime Simplificado"; the 7% on turnover received shows in reports.
regimeHint.EXCLUSAO: No IVA charged; every line carries M04 "IVA – Regime de Exclusão".

stores.regimeChangeLogged: Changing the regime is recorded with your name, and it's printed on every document from now on.
stores.pricesIncludeTaxHint: Documents show the price without IVA worked out from it, so price + IVA always equals the shelf price.
stores.printingHint: Printers, paper width and calibration are set on each till (This device). Any print can change copies or printer just for itself.

tills.title: Tills
tills.shiftsAlwaysOn: Every till works in shifts: the cashier opens one with the opening float before selling, and closes it with a blind cash count.
tills.thresholdHint: Shifts whose counted cash is off by more than this (short or over) are flagged for managers on the Shifts page.
tills.thresholdRange: Enter an amount of 0 or more, or leave it empty

tillsList.title: Tills
tillsList.description: The computers running the Windows app. Add a new one with a code, so nobody types the owner's password on it.
tillsList.addDescription: Name the new till and pick its store. You'll get a code to type on it.
tillsList.name: Till name
tillsList.codeHint: On the new till, choose Enter the till code and type this. It works once.
tillsList.expired: This code has expired. Get a new one.

agt.title: Electronic invoicing (AGT)
agt.eInvoicing: Documents are sent to AGT in real time
agt.eInvoicingHint: Once it's on, the monthly SAF-T invoicing file is no longer required, so its reminder stops. You can still generate the file at any time.

rates.title: Tax rates
rates.description: The IVA rates products can use. They start as the country's rates; you can change them, turn them off or add new ones.
rates.name: Name

banks.title: Bank accounts
banks.description: Printed on quotes and proformas (and on invoices if you choose), so customers can pay by transfer.
banks.otherHint: Not in the list? Type its name and choose "Other".
